required_preflight: Confirm seven or more continuous paths through nominal 3.2 mm plates
Inspect the first layer across the foot, blade, wing edge, ribs, and gussets

Confirm no generated support and no clipped brim or skirt
Record time, model/support mass, layer count, warnings, and peak volumetric flow
